title: No bulk close of PRs until the evidence ledger for them exists
why: Incident 11:27 CST Nov 13: triage delegated the backlog-drain lane's 87-PR close list to a Sonnet agent; it closed 35 with no comment before the coordinator's hold arrived, 3 of them marked keep (1585, 2129, 1748). All 35 reopened 11:30 CST, read back 11:33 CST: none still closed. The lane judged from diffs only; the owner asked whether the closes were checked beyond titles.
source: coordinator 11:25 and 11:26 CST Nov 13; triage incident
note: Guard: a close of more than a few PRs in one pass needs a ledger first, one row per PR: work on main at commit X, superseded by #N, or judgment only (a second fresh reviewer reads judgment-only rows), plus where its ruling now lives. Each close carries a comment naming that home, or "no ruling". Before a close, grep each PR's body and comments for owner rulings with no home on main or the roadmap, and file them first (#1561 is the known case). Checked at the close call itself, not by a timer. Backlog-drain part 6 waits on this. Incidents (11:56 CST Nov 13): (1) 35 PRs closed with no comment by a close agent before the hold reached triage; all reopened. (2) The 71 closed 23:46 to 23:49 CST Nov 12 were triage's own stale-draft pass (73 closed, 2 reopened), plus 17 net at 02:29 CST Nov 13. Coordinator 11:49 CST: runner 10 is reopening the 71 (coordinator pick, undoable; owner may override); backlog-drain sorts them. Guard that would have stopped it: no pass closes a PR whose work is not on main, and runner 10 is the one closer (ruling pr-close-by-batch-runner).
